fields.character_role: Mage - Self-taught occultist with a stolen part of herself
fields.armor1_details: Base 1 + two runes, +1 each; 6 rune slots.
fields.equipment1: Black Tower Laptop: Loaded rituals: Bless Weapon, Protect Object, Inspiration Hymn. Laptop access: +2 difficulty steps, twice the casting time. After 1 hour connected to the database, swap the rituals.
fields.equipment2: Stone with Memory-Manipulating Rune: Show the rune to other humans: they lose their memory of the last 30 minutes.
fields.equipment3: Injector Pen with Healing Salve: One use: heal 1d6 non-critical physical attribute damage.
fields.equipment4: Tarot Deck: Spend 1 Mana and 10 minutes to ask the GM one question. The answer must be true but may be cryptic.
fields.ability1_effect: Allows rituals from the Magic section. Emilia's normal pool is (5 + 2) x 2 = 14d6 for relevant Magic rolls. Rituals take time and can be interrupted. They cannot directly affect greater Eldritch powers or cosmic horrors, but may affect servants or infested areas. Cannot be combined with Nanomancy.
fields.ability2_cost: 3 Mana with Creator; Magical Ritual roll
fields.ability2_effect: Normal cost 2 Mana, increased by Creator to 3. Fire a high-pressure water jet: 1 Water damage for the first 6; each extra 6 doubles the damage.
fields.ability3_effect: Creation Magic costs 1 less Mana (minimum 1). Healing and Combat Spells cost 1 extra Mana. Cannot also select Healer or Destroyer. Once per scene, Genesis can avoid its superficial damage cost, but Emilia has not learned Genesis yet.
fields.power1_effect: Weapon gains an extra damage type for one scene: Bludgeoning, Slashing, Piercing, Fire, Water, Air, Electricity or Earth.
fields.power2_effect: Object gains +1 armor against a chosen damage type, excluding Void. The entry does not specify duration; agree with the GM.
fields.power3_effect: Allies gain +2 Social Interaction and +1 Athletics for one scene.
fields.background:
Emilia had been fascinated by the supernatural since childhood, collecting crystals and books about white magic. Everything changed when she found an untitled book in a second-hand shop. Its spells were real: if she followed the instructions exactly, they worked.

But a ritual she did not fully understand opened a portal to Hell. A demon emerged, seized her, and began draining something from her. Suddenly, it heard something following it through the portal and fled into the night. Emilia lost consciousness.

She awoke in GDA custody and received an ultimatum: work for them or never see daylight again.

GOAL: Find the demon and reclaim whatever it stole from her.

WEAKNESS: Emilia is convinced that she knows best, even in situations she does not understand.
fields.campaign_notes:
PLAYING ADVICE
Be the occult specialist: What you know about a phenomenon or creature can mean the difference between life and death.

Choose the right spell: Some creatures shrug off conventional weapons. Your magic can give the group a way to fight them.

Solve problems through creation: With the right specialization, you can create tools the group lacks.

NEXT STEPS
Creator is selected. Water Jet therefore costs 3 Mana, not its normal 2. Conjure Tool (125 XP) is a useful next purchase; Creator alone does not teach it. Genesis is also not yet learned, so its Creator synergy is a future benefit.

BETA / GM NOTES
The author has corrected the Mage to 3 discipline points. Emilia has Occult 2 (Magic) and Academia 1 (Chemistry); the extra Medicine 1 (Triage) entry has been removed. The laptop's three rituals are item access, not extra purchased abilities.

The complete prebuilt class equipment is retained. Carrying-slot accounting and any beta exceptions should be agreed with the GM. No spare equipment points or bonus XP have been added.
